PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_5 Code Coverage Gate
PHASE.GOAL: Add cargo-tarpaulin code coverage reporting and integrate it with Synapse test coverage output and CI evidence.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: make coverage runs cargo-tarpaulin with HTML and JSON reports under coverage/ and excludes tests and benches.
syn test coverage --code invokes or reads tarpaulin JSON, maps files to MyGRACE module IDs, and renders compact module-level coverage.
CI uploads coverage artifacts and fails when overall coverage is below the configured baseline threshold.
Workspace coverage can aggregate member coverage after single-project code coverage is stable.

STEPS.step-1: Implement CodeCoverageReport, ModuleCodeCoverage, tarpaulin command execution, and JSON parsing.
STEPS.step-2: Map tarpaulin source files to MyGRACE module IDs using graph-index-first metadata and source paths.
STEPS.step-3: Add syn test coverage --code output alongside the existing evidence coverage matrix.
STEPS.step-4: Add Makefile coverage targets and a GitHub Actions coverage job with artifact upload.
STEPS.step-5: Mark modules below the code coverage threshold in compact text and JSON output.
STEPS.step-6: Resolve repository scenario paths correctly under cargo-tarpaulin test runner cwd changes.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: syn test coverage --code renders evidence and code coverage sections.
make coverage produces coverage/tarpaulin-report.html and coverage/tarpaulin-report.json.
CI coverage job uploads the coverage report artifact.
Coverage threshold failure produces a clear message instead of a panic.
Repository E2E scenario tests pass under cargo-tarpaulin.

RISKS.RISK: Initial measured coverage is 67.34 percent locally; start with a 65 percent gate and ratchet upward after targeted tests.
cargo-tarpaulin may be unavailable locally; CLI should print an actionable install message.
